title: happy-sdk i18n translation file (schema version 2)
description: Shape of a github.com/happy-sdk/happy/pkg/i18n translation file that describes its own bundle identity and locale(s), rather than relying on its filename. This document is for editors and humans only - it is never read at runtime; github.com/happy-sdk/happy/pkg/i18n/schema/v2 is the authoritative, enforced definition.
$comment: "source" is optional (defaults to "en"); "notes" now lives per-locale inside each "locales" entry - see $defs/localeEntry.

version.description: This schema version. Required - a document with no "version" key at all is schema version 1 instead (see v1/schema.json).

bundle.description: This document's root/bundle identifier: either a bare word (e.g. "app") or a dot-separated, reverse-DNS-style path mirroring the owning Go module's import path (e.g. "com.github.example.app").

source.description: The locale this bundle's translations are authored/maintained in - the one every other locale is translated from. Defaults to "en" when omitted.

locales.description: One entry per locale this document carries. Keys are BCP 47/ISO 639-1 language tags (e.g. "en", "de", "zh-Hant"). A document may hold just one locale (if a maintainer prefers one file per language) or every locale an application supports in a single exportable file - both are valid.

notes.description: Optional, free-text context for translators/tooling, specific to this locale (not the whole bundle - see "source"). Has no effect on rendering.

tree.description: A locale's translation tree: every key is either a nested group (another tree) or a Message (an object holding "$message"). Key names must be lowercase a-z, 0-9, or "_" - except "$message" itself.

msg.description: The template. A bare {name} or {name:verb} placeholder is a literal argument; a placeholder whose name matches a key in "fragments" resolves to that fragment's own rendering instead.

fragments.description: Named, variable pieces of msg - each one a plural/ordinal/select choice of wording.

kind.description: Defaults to "plural" when omitted. "plural": CLDR cardinal category (quantity). "ordinal": CLDR ordinal category (rank: 1st/2nd/3rd). "select": exact match against arg's own value, for closed sets like gender or formality.

arg.description: The argument name (passed via i18n.T/i18n.TL) whose value selects a form below.

other.description: Required. The universal fallback: used whenever the rendering language doesn't distinguish the selected category, or (for "select") the value has no dedicated form.

additionalProperties.description: "select" fragments may use arbitrary literal values as form keys beyond zero/one/two/few/many/other; "plural"/"ordinal" fragments are restricted to the real CLDR category names.

description.description: Documents this Message for translator/tooling use. Has no effect on rendering.

msg.description: What this message is for / where it appears.

description.description: What this argument represents. Never include a "type" field here - it is always derived automatically from the verb the template actually uses for this arg, never hand-authored.
